decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood explicitly authorized continuing after the replacement question disclosed the full v9.0.2-motrix.2 scope and all 42 residual advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low). CI run 36812820986 passed all nine required checks for that implementation before this decision. Restored files are reauthenticated against current pins before compilation; no compiled or signing inputs are cached. Locked source archives and URLs, toolchains, Action references, and all inventoried residual risks are unchanged. Audit 36807648066 is the same-day complete inventory. No vulnerability is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction risks before validation and the signature type-binding advisory. The previous v9.0.2-motrix.1 exception is not reused and its annotated tag remains immutable with no public Release. Preserve every signing, notarization, independent-verification, Immutable Releases and protected-Environment confirmation gate. This authorization is neither an Environment approval nor an exception for another tag, changed inputs, new advisories, or publication beyond the deadline.
